title: Umwizera wihishe
intro: Mu byumba by’ubutegetsi by’akataraboneka, aho ukwemera n’igitugu byari byiganje, ijwi rimwe rukumbi ry’ukuri ryavugiye ahantu hatunguranye. Uyu muntu yahize ububasha bwo kurinda intumwa, yishyira mu kaga umutekano we kugira ngo avuge ukuri.
clues: Nabaye mu gihugu cy’igitugu gikomeye, nkorera umutegetsi wiyitaga Imana.
Namaze imyaka myinshi nhisha imyizerere yanjye nyakuri, ntinya ingaruka zo kuyihishura.
Iyo intumwa yazaga ifite ibimenyetso bisobanutse, nemeraga, ariko abantu banjye bayigambaniye.
Nahagaze imbere y'umunyagitugu n'inama ye, mvuga ko badakwiye kwica intumwa y'inzirakarengane.
Nababuriye ku bihano by’amahanga ya kera yanze ukuri, nk’abantu ba Nuhu na 'Ad.
Allah yankijije imigambi mibi yabo, kandi niboneye isenywa ry'ubutegetsi bw'igitugu.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
